prompt.project_info: Hyper-realistic ultra-detailed night street portrait of one clearly adult woman, with cinematic rim lighting, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain and realistic urban atmosphere.
prompt.main_subject: One clearly adult woman with long wavy dark-brown hair, wearing a black leather jacket over a simple white T-shirt. She has a serious intense gaze directed slightly off-camera, natural anatomy and realistic skin texture. Use an original identity with no public-figure likeness.
prompt.composition_elements: Frame the adult woman as the clear subject in a close portrait on a dark blurred city street at night. Keep the black leather jacket and white T-shirt readable while subtle neon reflections and distant urban forms establish the environment. Use cinematic profile emphasis without changing the source's serious expression or clothing.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Use cinematic rim lighting to highlight the profile and hair, with moody high-contrast exposure, subtle neon reflections, realistic street shadows and restrained nocturnal color. Include slight 35mm film grain for raw texture.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 8K-style portrait, high-end DSLR aesthetic, 85mm portrait lens, f/1.8 shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, realistic leather, cotton, hair and skin texture, no text, logo or watermark.
